# GitHub Repository Topics

> **Configuration note**: This file documents the recommended GitHub repository
> topics. To apply them, go to **Settings → General → Topics** on GitHub and
> paste this list (GitHub allows up to 20 topics).

Add these topics to https://github.com/Namitjain07/agent-memory/settings:

```
ai
ai-agent
ai-memory
agent
agent-memory
anthropic
chatbot
claude
embeddings
llm
llm-agent
llm-memory
memory
openai
persistence
rag
semantic-search
typescript
vector-search
vercel-ai-sdk
```

**Why these topics?**

- `ai`, `ai-agent`, `ai-memory` — broad category for AI tooling search.
- `agent`, `agent-memory`, `memory` — primary keywords developers search.
- `llm`, `llm-agent`, `llm-memory` — variant spellings.
- `anthropic`, `claude`, `openai` — popular LLM providers people search alongside.
- `chatbot`, `rag`, `semantic-search` — use cases.
- `embeddings`, `vector-search` — technical category.
- `persistence` — storage category.
- `typescript` — language filter.
- `vercel-ai-sdk` — popular integration.

GitHub enforces a 20-topic limit and rejects duplicates. The list above is
already at the limit, so adding a new one means removing another.
